pages.name: Appaloosa
pages.text: Famous for the leopard-spot pattern — Appaloosas are the only breed in the guide whose coat always carries $(thing)dots$(). Tough, athletic, and historically a Nez Perce favorite.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text: Always with $(thing)Dots$() markings:$(br2)$(li)White + Black Dots$()$(li)Gray + Black Dots$()$(li)Chestnut + White Dots$()$(li)Brown + White Dots$()$(li)Black + White Dots$()$(li)Dark Brown + White Dots$()
